name: Prizm Neon
desc: Acid-green neon tube web over wet black asphalt. The exact web the paint lights up carries the spec: M traces the tube cores, Cc is the soft glow halo bleeding past them, and R rides the fine asphalt grit that also textures the paint base.
ignition: Every glowing green tube line in the paint is itself the hot line — the s^1 web fires at M~255 so the whole circuit flash-ignites when the sun walks across it (saffron polarity).

name: Prizm Oceanic
desc: Deep teal sea built from three married fields: a depth ramp (R), aqua caustic webbing the paint glows with (M shimmer), and scattered abyss-current arcs the paint drops to black-teal. Same seeds in paint and spec throughout.
ignition: The abyss arcs (s^3) that read as dark undertow shadows in the paint flash to Cc~255 wet glass at angle — black water suddenly gleaming.

name: Prizm Phoenix
desc: Red-orange-magenta fire plumes with a second population of charred feathers burnt to near-black in the paint. Spec marries the same petals: Cc varnishes the living flames, R rides the flicker noise that stirs the ramp, M lives only on the char.
ignition: The charred feathers (s^2 petals) resurrect — burnt-black in albedo, they ignite at M~255 chrome when the light comes around: the phoenix rebirth moment.

name: Prizm Solar
desc: Gold solar granulation (ring-swarm plasma cells) pocked with dark sunspot umbrae. The spec rides the same three fields: Cc glosses the granulation crests, R follows the plasma jitter, M sits only in the sunspots.
ignition: The dark sunspots (s^2 dots, near-black umbrae in paint) blow out at M~255 — black holes in the gold that turn into blinding mirrors at the right sun angle.

name: Prizm Spectrum
desc: Five-stop rainbow field cut by bright white prism slashes that the paint renders hot. Three aspects of the same system: M traces the slashes, R steps per hue band, Cc pools lacquer around the spectrum's center band.
ignition: The white prism slashes visible in the paint (s^2 streaks) are the M~255 hot lines — the rainbow stays at half-power until a slash catches the sun and detonates.

name: Prizm Sunset Strip
desc: Multi-angle sunset bands running orange to hot pink and sinking into after-dark purple-black, strung with warm marquee bulbs. All channels ride the same band field: M on the night end, R peaked at the pink mid-band, Cc on the bulb dots the paint glows with.
ignition: The after-dark end of the sunset ramp — painted nearly black — is one huge hidden mirror (M~252): when the angle lines up the night side of the strip lights up like the Sunset Strip at dusk.

name: Prizm Titanium
desc: Heat-tempered titanium: quantized temper zones colored by interference physics over multi-angle brushing. The hottest temper plateau is scorched near-black in paint; M owns exactly that zone, R rides the brush grain, Cc wets the temper seam lines between zones.
ignition: The burnt top temper zone (temper==3 of the same quantized field) is the detonator — matte black heat-scar head-on, M~255 polished-titanium mirror when the sun rakes it.

name: Prizm Toxic Waste
desc: Acid-green drips over dark sludge with dim rising bubbles. Spec marries the same fields: M traces the glowing drip streaks, Cc gleams the bubbles (plus a faint drip halo), R follows the sludge grain that also modulates the paint base.
ignition: Every glowing drip line in the paint (s^1 streaks) fires at M~255 — the spill turns to liquid chrome rivulets when the sun catches it, while the sludge stays dead matte.

name: Prizm Venom
desc: Micro-voronoi scale skin: acid-green cells against deep venom-violet cells chosen by ONE shared per-cell rng draw (same s^2 in paint and spec — the exact independent-draw mistake fixed). M lights only the dark venom cells, R hardens the cell membranes, Cc pools droplets at every cell heart.
ignition: The deep-violet venom cells — the darkest scales on the car — flip to M~255 chrome at angle: the venom literally glints, while the green scales and membranes stay quiet.
